properties.name: A1737/26 / TQPF
properties.originalText:
AD LIMITED TO HELICOPTER OPS BY HELICOPTERS WITH MAXIMUM D-VALUE
OF 15M. AFTER LANDING, HELICOPTERS SHALL VACATE RWY 11/29 VIA TWY
ALPHA, GROUND TAXI AND/OR AIR-TAXI TO THE SOUTHWEST AREA OF THE
APRON. ALL HELICOPTER MOVEMENTS ON APRON SHALL BE CONDUCTED UNDER
MARSHALLER INSTRUCTIONS.
PILOTS SHALL COMPLY WITH ATC INSTRUCTIONS AND EXER CTN DUE TO OTHER
ACFT, VEHICLES, PERSONNEL AND EQPT.
